    | text      = And I just felt led by God to go to him and talk to him about Christ and God.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:16.980
    | text      = And then he he accepted Christ right there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:19.619
    | text      = I don't think the old man was lying.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:20.579
    | text      = I don't believe anybody knows the story.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:21.859
    | text      = Maybe it was made up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:23.220
    | text      = But but but then I talked to locals and I talked to Tucker and he'd heard about it from
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:26.259
    | text      = them that actually happened.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:27.460
    | text      = So was that a true story?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:29.220
    | text      = I don't remember being in the water in my clothes, but it's the sort of thing I might
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:32.660
    | text      = have done.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:33.380
    | text      = OK, so in religious circles, what Alex is doing is super rude.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:38.180
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:38.579
    | text      = Your conversion to Christ is your story.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:41.059
    | text      = It's your testimony of how the Lord moved in you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:43.619
    | text      = And it is deeply personal.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:45.859
    | text      = It's something that's happening inside you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:48.259
    | text      = So for Alex to tell this story without Russell's consent, not knowing if it's even true is
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:52.819
    | text      = really offensive.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:54.420
    | text      = Alex is creating this very standard seeing the light type of scene for Russell to sign
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:58.740
    | text      = off on.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:59.299
    | text      = And by doing so, he's putting Russell in the position of having to adopt this as the moment
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:03.940
    | text      = that he found God or to say that this guy Alex was talking to was full of shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:08.500
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:08.740
    | text      = Not a good position.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:09.700
    | text      = If he chooses the first one, then Alex is now dictating his relationship with God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:14.740
    | text      = If he chooses the second, it seriously calls into question how easily Alex will just believe
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:19.380
    | text      = random gossip.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:21.059
    | text      = There's no good response for Russell to what Alex is doing, but the choice he makes is
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:25.779
    | text      = actually a third worse path.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:28.019
    | text      = The moment you accept Christ into your heart is supposed to be the most important moment
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:31.539
    | text      = of your life.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:32.180
    | text      = So the way that Russell says, well, it sounds like something I might do is kind of trivializing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:36.740
    | text      = the divine.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:37.460
    | text      = I mean, let's be honest.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:38.420
    | text      = I've accepted Christ into my heart pretty much at the beginning of every rape trial.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:41.940
    | text      = So I don't know if you know me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:44.420
    | text      = I'm a lady slayer.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:45.700
    | text      = I'm a little crazy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:46.740
    | text      = It might have been out there in the water talking to this old man for a couple hours
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:49.539
    | text      = and finding God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:51.140
    | text      = It happens all the time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:52.019
    | text      = It's just one of the easiest things to do in terms of the sleight of hand of being like,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:57.539
    | text      = yeah, an old man told me the story.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:59.460
    | text      = You tell me the story.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:00.660
    | text      = And then you just confirm that the old man said that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:03.059
    | text      = Right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:03.299
    | text      = That's just the quick sleight of hand.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:04.660
    | text      = I know I saw it coming.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:05.940
    | text      = You tell the story because it's your personal story.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:08.740
    | text      = And then we can all share in this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:10.500
    | text      = But also I'm a genius.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:11.539
    | text      = I knew it in advance.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:12.579
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:13.220
    | text      = If Alex had just let Russell tell his story, he could add details and association.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:19.460
    | text      = Himself instead of what is very uncomfortable and not a cool thing to do to somebody.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:26.099
    | text      = I met a stranger and they told me they helped you find God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:29.380
    | text      = That sounded true to me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:30.500
    | text      = So I believed in this old man who saved your soul.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:33.059
    | text      = Now you're here and I'm telling it to you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:35.859
    | text      = Weird wild.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:37.220
    | text      = So Alex, he's stuck on this old man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:42.420
    | text      = Because of course, he's not a fixate on the worst.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:44.579
    | text      = Russell's like, shut up about the old man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:47.779
    | text      = Did you have your main conversion on book around there?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:50.579
    | text      = What happened was is, look, I can understand why people would be cynical about anything.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:54.579
    | text      = Look at the world that we occupy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:56.819
    | text      = What information can you trust?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:58.740
    | text      = Like we went to the old man said you were.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:00.420
    | text      = He started talking for you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:01.220
    | text      = All right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:02.339
    | text      = The old man like this old man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:05.299
    | text      = I don't know about this old man, but what I can tell you is my son, Mike, of coming to Christ for me
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:09.859
    | text      = was like the inevitable discovery of someone that has always been there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:14.900
    | text      = Always been there present.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:16.980
    | text      = Initially, Alex, the reason, as I said, that was like discovering yourself.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:20.500
    | text      = Yeah, because it's the deep truth within you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:23.059
    | text      = Like all of us are familiar with a second voice in our head that sometimes self-condemnatory
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:27.380
    | text      = that tells you you're not good enough, that you're worthless.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:30.019
    | text      = Many of us are trapped in a constant inner dialogue with kind of.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:33.859
    | text      = That's why Satan's called the accuser.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:35.380
    | text      = Well, I wonder if it's demonic.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:36.740
    | text      = I do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:37.779
    | text      = The devil tells you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:38.579
    | text      = No, it is good.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:39.859
    | text      = I hear you, man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:41.140
    | text      = I hear you, man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:42.180
    | text      = Hey, buddy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:43.380
    | text      = I want to say that it's normal to have varying degrees of internal dialogue in your head.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:48.019
    | text      = It's not demons.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:49.220
    | text      = It's thoughts.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:50.579
    | text      = Sometimes these thoughts follow an intentional path and sometimes you have stray thoughts,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:54.740
    | text      = but neither is a demon.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:56.900
    | text      = When we experience higher levels of stress or life setbacks, it can be easy to feel like
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:01.140
    | text      = you're having more thoughts that are negative and that you're not in control of them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:05.299
    | text      = It's hard, but therapy can really help on that front.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:08.339
    | text      = We all learn lessons in life that we don't realize we're learning, and sometimes they're wrong.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:12.819
    | text      = We learn the wrong lesson.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:14.819
    | text      = Like, maybe we fail at something that we really wanted to succeed at, and that can teach you
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:18.900
    | text      = that you're not good enough.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:20.819
    | text      = You take away a negative lesson from the experience and you tell yourself that you're just not
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:24.660
    | text      = the kind of person who succeeds, and then this gets repeated in your brain.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:28.980
    | text      = If you just allow these thoughts and lessons that you learn to go unexamined in your head,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:33.460
    | text      = then you can end up falling into patterns where every time you fail, you tell yourself,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:37.539
    | text      = of course I failed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:38.420
    | text      = That's what I do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:39.619
    | text      = And every time you succeed, you tell yourself that you didn't deserve to and it must have
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:43.059
    | text      = been an accident.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:44.420
    | text      = Getting out of these patterns is hard and the solution isn't magical, but you can challenge
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:48.259
    | text      = the thoughts you have if you can identify them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:51.059
    | text      = Then, when you identify them, you have to challenge them, and there's plenty of ways
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:55.779
    | text      = to do that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:56.900
    | text      = Critical analysis works by taking thoughts like, I'm supposed to fail, and asking why,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:01.460
    | text      = until you see that this belief is based on nothing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:04.339
    | text      = You could take a religious approach of confronting these things too, where you ask, why am I
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:09.220
    | text      = not just meant to fail?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:10.500
    | text      = And the answer is, because God loves you, and he didn't make you just to fail.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:13.940
    | text      = There you go.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:14.740
    | text      = There isn't one right or wrong way to take care of yourself, but I do know that pretending
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:18.980
    | text      = that all this conflict in your head is the work of demons is lazy, counterproductive,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:23.539
    | text      = and something that a fraud would want you to think, which is what these two assholes
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:26.980
    | text      = are.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:27.539
    | text      = So fuck them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:28.819
    | text      = Yeah, I mean, it's just the simplest thing to steal from a person is their own thoughts.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:37.059
    | text      = To take from them, like, yeah, I know whatever you think is you, that's not you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:42.980
    | text      = I am telling you that it's demons outside of you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:46.500
    | text      = So in this transaction of our conversation, the you you think you are does not exist at
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:52.500
    | text      = all.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:52.740
    | text      = It's just me and the demons, and you have to either do what I say or the demons, so
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:56.660
    | text      = you're going to do what I say, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:58.259
    | text      = You're not going to think for a single second, maybe I just think things.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:03.059
    | text      = I really resent this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:04.740
    | text      = I think it's really on all the levels that these people are just assholes and they're
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:11.380
    | text      = bad.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:11.700
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:12.099
    | text      = Like this kind of perpetuation of the bad things about you or the devil.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:17.460
    | text      = That I really think robs people of the tools and the energy that they need to actually
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:24.900
    | text      = address issues that really suck and are hard.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:29.460
    | text      = They're hard to deal with.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:30.740
    | text      = They are the process of becoming.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:32.819
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:33.539
    | text      = And magic isn't going to work.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:35.299
    | text      = No, it's just not.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:36.660
    | text      = It's just not.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:37.859
    | text      = So Russell, I think that because he used to wear leather coats and do heroin, I think
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:42.579
    | text      = he still thinks that he's edgy and he considers himself an apostate of the culture.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:49.779
    | text      = Boo.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:50.900
    | text      = When Christ appears on the plane of your consciousness, when the spirit moves over the water, when
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:56.099
    | text      = the prima materia of consciousness is infused with the divine, you discover that an aspect
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:01.539
    | text      = of yourself is Christ.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:02.740
    | text      = Now, I don't mean that in a grandiose way.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:04.900
    | text      = I'm not claiming any personal or particular access to Christ.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:08.339
    | text      = I'm saying, in fact, that that was obscured from me most of my life.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:11.940
    | text      = I was worshiping the culture.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:13.539
    | text      = In fact, more interesting, perhaps than my conversion to Christ is my apostasy against
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:18.740
    | text      = the culture that I was a priest for previously.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:21.299
    | text      = When you're in Hollywood and you're making a bunch of money and you're having a load
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:23.940
    | text      = of sex and everyone's telling you you're fantastic, you don't realize that you're an appointed
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:28.420
    | text      = voice of the system.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:29.700
    | text      = It becomes very obvious with someone like Yuval Noah Harari, the writer of Sapiens,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:33.539
    | text      = who probably is a legit guy, but there's a reason that his books are Barack Obama's favorite
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:38.259
    | text      = books, because those books are telling you you don't have a chance, you don't have a
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:42.099
    | text      = future.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:42.740
    | text      = AI has already...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:43.700
    | text      = You don't have free will.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:45.619
    | text      = Wow.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:46.819
    | text      = Wait, so you think you have free will?
}}
